data.define: Short for "not gonna lie", before an honest opinion.

misuse.text: Don't use 'ngl' in a job application.

publish.title: What does "ngl" mean?
publish.value: Ngl = Not gonna lie. Example: "Ngl, I loved that movie." (very casual English, US).
